metadata.description: Seattle-area general-market rental apartment communities with dedicated leasing websites and shared amenities.

criteria.area: Any city within the driving-time limit of South Lake Union, Seattle
criteria.rental_type: Whole rental apartment community; exclude individually owned condominium buildings.
criteria.leasing_website: A dedicated property website or operator-hosted page must provide rental listings, availability or an official vacancy channel that reports no available units.
criteria.eligibility: Open general-market rentals. Optional income-restricted units are allowed; primarily income-restricted or population-restricted housing is excluded.

methodology.coordinates: Google Maps Geocoding API using street addresses as inputs.
methodology.routing: Google Routes API DRIVE with TRAFFIC_UNAWARE; shortest returned static duration among default and alternative routes, from the SLU reference point to each property. No live traffic or departure time.
methodology.unknown_values: Unverified construction years and management companies are null.
methodology.sources: Per-property source URLs document the facts each source supports.
methodology.vacancy_status: Buildings may be fully leased. The directory requires an official, functioning vacancy channel even when no unit is available on the research date.
methodology.coverage: The directory covers all 195 original entries and additional properties researched by neighborhood. It does not cover every qualifying Seattle-area building.

pricing.description: Approximate effective monthly 1BR cost, rounded to $10, including disclosed mandatory fees and applicable standard concessions over the quoted lease term; 12 months assumed where unquoted. Pricing-research-cohort bedroom-ratio extrapolation when no usable 1BR quote. The ten unpriced buildings were removed at the user's request on 2026-10-09; their records and pricing evidence remain in generation-rules/research-audit.json.

methodology.construction_year_audit: The 29 construction years missing on 2026-10-09 were audited by one dedicated researcher per entry. Sources and notes identify the building or phase dated, original structures versus redevelopment, and material conflicts; the complete evidence and review decisions are in generation-rules/research-audit.json. The Magnolia Collection uses its oldest building year at the user's request.
methodology.amenities_audit: Shared amenities for buildings constructed in 2020 or later were rechecked on 2026-10-09, with one dedicated researcher per building. Per-amenity evidence, pages checked and unresolved questions are recorded in generation-rules/research-audit.json.

amenity_consolidation.description: Names-only normalization; no building research or inclusion changes. amenities contains deduplicated feature labels, not room counts or an amenity score. amenities_original is the reusable source of truth; amenity_details links each label to original descriptions, retaining shared-space relationships, quantities and all qualifiers. Ambiguous names remain conservative and are flagged.

single_amenity_exclusion.description: Removed at the user's request on 2026-10-09 because exactly one normalized amenity remained and it was not a fitness center/gym.
